وقد تم إنشاء المستند بمعرفة كل من السيد المهندس /
محمد سليم سالمان والسيد المهندس / أحمد مصطفى الصباغ 
بتاريخ 14 يونيو 2003م. 
وتمت المراسلات الاليكترونية خلال الانترنت بمساعدة المهندس/ محمد سليم سالمان

وقد 
تم تنفيذه بناءً على الخبرة السابقة بمعرفة السيد المهندس / أحمد مصطفى الصباغ وتمت 
مراجعة المستند بمعرفة السيد المهندس / عبودة البنا مهندس 
التفتيش ومراقبة الجودة والسيد المهندس / محمد السيد عبد 
الغفار مدير عام المحطة واعتماده من السيد المهندس / عوض محمد فتحي رئيس قطاع 
المحطات.

sections_en.text: This document covers the periodic maintenance of submersible pumps. The document was prepared by Eng. Mohamed Salim Salman and Eng. Ahmed Mostafa El-Sabbagh on 14 June 2003. The electronic correspondence was carried out over the Internet with the assistance of Eng. Mohamed Salim Salman.

It was implemented based on previous experience by Eng. Ahmed Mostafa El-Sabbagh. The document was reviewed by Eng. Abouda El-Banna, Inspection and Quality Control Engineer, and Eng. Mohamed El-Sayed Abdel Ghaffar, General Manager of the station, and approved by Eng. Awad Mohamed Fathy, Head of the Power Stations Sector.

items: Issue an approved work order from the competent authority, stating the industrial safety category
Fence off the work area and place warning signs.
Isolate the pump electrically and take the switch out of service.
Isolate the pump mechanically by closing the discharge valve.
Wear personal protective equipment and use safety equipment: helmet, shoes, ear muffs and gloves.
Helmet and safety shoes
Chain block or Tirfor and its accessories (wire ropes and locks).
Complete tool set: wrenches of all types, open-end, ring and Allen keys.
Vernier caliper and dial caliper.
6-inch puller and feeler gauge.
Wooden blocks.
Tazga.
Cleaning materials and rags.

sections_en.text: Spare parts that may be changed as required:
Work steps to be carried out

rows: Rig the chain block or Tirfor, or use the beach shed winch, in preparation for lifting the pump.
Undo the bolts connecting the motor to the pump.
Lift the motor and place it on wooden blocks in a vertical position.
Sling the pump and lift it from its place.
Place the pump on wooden blocks on the ground.
Disconnect the pump cooling connections (bearing cooling) for model ABG 80-160 GAV.
Measure the clearance of the impellers with the stationary part and record it.
Dismantle the outer casing of the impellers.
Measure the clearance of the shaft with the bearings and record it.
Dismantle the pump connections and remove the bearings and check for any wear in the bearing parts or shaft sleeves.
Dismantle the upper shaft bearing and check the bearing and its condition.
Wash the parts well and replace the discharge O-rings.
After inspection and testing and verifying the condition, replacement is carried out as required.
After the repair and reinstallation are complete, run the pump and check the condition in terms of:

- Vibration - discharge pressure and quantity - motor operating current
Bearing temperature
in accordance with the performance curves

Introduction
This document covers the periodic maintenance of submersible pumps. The document was prepared by Eng. Mohamed Salim Salman and Eng. Ahmed Mostafa El-Sabbagh on 14 June 2003. The electronic correspondence was carried out over the Internet with the assistance of Eng. Mohamed Salim Salman.
It was implemented based on previous experience by Eng. Ahmed Mostafa El-Sabbagh. The document was reviewed by Eng. Abouda El-Banna, Inspection and Quality Control Engineer, and Eng. Mohamed El-Sayed Abdel Ghaffar, General Manager of the station, and approved by Eng. Awad Mohamed Fathy, Head of the Power Stations Sector.
Safety precautions
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority, stating the industrial safety category
Fence off the work area and place warning signs.
Isolate the pump electrically and take the switch out of service.
Isolate the pump mechanically by closing the discharge valve.
Wear personal protective equipment and use safety equipment: helmet, shoes, ear muffs and gloves.
Tools, instruments and equipment used
Helmet and safety shoes
Helmet and safety shoes
Chain block or Tirfor and its accessories (wire ropes and locks).
Complete tool set: wrenches of all types, open-end, ring and Allen keys.
Vernier caliper and dial caliper.
6-inch puller and feeler gauge.
Wooden blocks.
Tazga.
Cleaning materials and rags.

Work steps to be carried out
Open the work order. | 1
Disconnect the pump. | 2
Rig the chain block or Tirfor, or use the beach shed winch, in preparation for lifting the pump. | 3
Disconnect the motor terminals. | 4
Undo the bolts connecting the motor to the pump. | 5
Lift the motor and place it on wooden blocks in a vertical position. | 6
Disconnect the pump discharge line. | 7
Undo the pump base. | 8
Sling the pump and lift it from its place. | 9
Place the pump on wooden blocks on the ground. | 10
Disconnect the pump cooling connections (bearing cooling) for model ABG 80-160 GAV. | 11
Measure the clearance of the impellers with the stationary part and record it. | 12
Dismantle the outer casing of the impellers. | 13
Measure the clearance of the shaft with the bearings and record it. | 14
Dismantle the pump connections and remove the bearings and check for any wear in the bearing parts or shaft sleeves. | 15
Dismantle the shaft connections. | 16
Dismantle the upper shaft bearing and check the bearing and its condition. | 17
Wash the parts well and replace the discharge O-rings. | 18
After inspection and testing and verifying the condition, replacement is carried out as required. | 19
Reassemble in reverse order. | 20
After the repair and reinstallation are complete, run the pump and check the condition in terms of: | 21
- Vibration - discharge pressure and quantity - motor operating current
Bearing temperature
in accordance with the performance curves |
